paragraphs: The Maybach S580 is the V8-powered version of Mercedes-Maybach's flagship luxury saloon. It uses the M176 — a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with mild hybrid technology, shared with other high-end Mercedes models of its era. The engine first appeared in the X222-generation Maybach S560 (which used the same M176 from 2017), then continued into the Z223 Maybach S580 from 2021. It's a smooth, powerful unit, and while no specific engine issue is yet confirmed as a widespread pattern for this application, we service it to the same high standard as every other V8 in our workshop.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every MAYBACH S580 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the MAYBACH S580 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The Maybach S580 consistently uses the M176 V8 across its production run. However, engine and ECU specifications can vary by year and market — which is why we always confirm your exact VIN or registration before quoting or supplying anything. This ensures you get exactly the right components for your car.
